column1: # origin.hypothesis=TimesFM may forecast sensor/chat-log signals while Spark-X2.5-4B or MiniCPM5-2B may serve as a compact local mind.
# origin.question=Can these three models improve wake by predicting useful next states or handling local mind work on this node?

# origin.acceptance=Produce dated artifacts with reproducible commands, real resource/latency measurements, forecast or task-quality metrics, and an explicit adopt/reject recommendation for each model.
# origin.feedback=Report findings to the operator and board; do not wire a model into live wake before the evaluation artifact supports it.

column3: Write the evaluation harness/fixtures and baseline: identify available sensor series and chat.log-derived series, define leakage-safe train/validation splits, wake-use cases, resource budget, and reproducible artifact schema; cite the three model cards and license constraints.

Evaluate google/timesfm-3.0-pytorch on numeric sensor series plus aggregated chat.log/wake activity series where valid; compare against seasonal/naive baselines, report horizon/coverage/error, cold/warm latency, RAM/VRAM, and whether the output can produce an actionable wake signal without false certainty.

Evaluate XHToken/Spark-X2.5-4B and openbmb/MiniCPM5-2B locally using the same prompt fixtures from recent operator/mesh work; measure load time, steady latency/tokens, peak RAM/VRAM, context fit, Russian/English instruction following, structured tool/task output, and isolation from the existing Ollama service.

Produce a comparison and recommendation: adopt, keep as offline research, or reject for each model; include artifacts, exact commands, licensing/deployment caveats, failure modes, and the smallest reversible next integration step if any. No live wake wiring is allowed without this evidence.
